rv.q: Briony lives with the guilt of that lie long after Robbie has been sent to prison and then the frontline of the second world war. Director Adam Penford’s production does a masterful job of transposing elements of the story to the stage through sound and design.
Ian McEwan’s tale of love, lust and lies loses its bite in this stage adaptation
Atonement is a time-bending story filled with interesting characters, war, love and more twists and turns than a funfair helter-skelter.

Fifty five years later he continues to write at a prodigious pace, whether adaptations of other work, musical theatre libretti and lyrics, with Lloyd Webber , Don Black and others, and original endeavours.
